description: This file contains utility methods for handling user preferences within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes permission checks, conversion routines for preference data, and helper methods for managing user preference data maps.

classes.name: PreferenceWorker
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to manage user preferences, including permission checks, preference data conversions, and utility functions for preference maps within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addPrefToMap
methods.description: Adds a preference record (GenericValue) to the user preference map, converting data types as necessary.

methods.name: checkCopyPermission
methods.description: Verifies if a user has permission to copy preferences based on their admin rights.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to get or set preferences based on action type.

methods.name: createUserPrefMap
methods.description: Converts a single or list of preference GenericValues into a user preference map.

methods.name: getUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves the user login ID from the context, defaulting to a special value if none is available.

methods.name: isValidGetId
methods.description: Determines if the current user has valid permissions to view preferences for a specified userLoginId.

methods.name: isValidSetId
methods.description: Determines if the current user has valid permissions to set preferences for a specified userLoginId.

methods.name: toFieldMap
methods.description: Builds a map suitable for creating or updating preference records, including data type conversions.
